visual_action: A montage of clips showing the interior and exterior of a large arena, identified as the United Center in Chicago, being set up for the 2024 Democratic National Convention. The footage includes wide shots of the empty arena with a stage and large video screens displaying event branding ('CHICAGO DNC 2024'), a group of people walking through the stands, a hallway with digital countdown clocks, and the building's exterior. The large screens inside the arena briefly show video clips, one featuring Joe Biden with military personnel and another featuring a woman resembling Kamala Harris with a young girl.
